svg.title: Enterprise incident-to-production flow
svg.desc: A Crashlytics crash is picked up by the monitor agent, which logs an incident. The seven-agent council writes the root-cause analysis. A requirement gap becomes a change request; a defect goes straight to the fix. Design, code, a pull request with checks, and review by two agents in Autopilot or two humans in Manual mode follow. The PR waits, ready to deploy, until a person flips the human-in-the-loop switch to release to production.

g.text: PR is ready to deploy · waits for you

svg.text: a bot owns every step · 2 reviewer agents
The production switch always stays with a person.
